No Hyphenation

Hyphenation is a mechanism that allows text to break appropriately across lines by inserting hyphens at syllable boundaries. It improves readability and optimizes justification in fully justified text. Commonly hyphenated words include extraordinary, organization, availability, responsibility, development, internationalization, and communication.

Custom hyphenation without static hyphenator or typestting


The word “entertainment” has a custom hyphenation. It will break at index 5 _______________________ entertainment.

Prevent break rules without static hyphenator or typestting


Words that start or end with “self” are reserved to be written without a hyphen, so if they don’t fit at the end of a line, they will move to the next line — for example: myself
